page.title: to不定詞は足りない情報を補う

analysis.summaryJa: be＋to不定詞は、単なる未来ではなく、予定・公式な取り決め、義務、可能性、運命という『設計された未来』を表す。条件節のif S is/are to doと、実現しなかった予定を示すwas/were to have doneも文脈で区別する。
grammarPoints: be to doで公式な予定・取り決めを表す
命令・規則の文脈では義務を表す
否定・疑問などで可能性を表すことがある
物語的文脈では後の運命を表す
if S is/are to doで目標達成に必要な条件を示す
was/were to have doneで実現しなかった予定を表す
visualEvidence: BEの設計台からTOの未来線が予定・義務・可能・運命へ分岐する図
カレンダー、規則標識、鍵穴、運命の道の四つのアイコン
IFゲートから目標へ向かう条件矢印
過去の予定線が破線になり未実現を示す配置
commonTraps: beを落としてto不定詞だけで予定を表す
予定・義務・可能・運命を文脈なしに決める
was to have doneを実現済みと誤解する
be toの後ろに過去形や-ing形を置く

questions.prompt: The new director is ------- the staff Monday.
questions.translationJa: 新任部長は月曜に職員と会う予定です。
questions.explanationJa: 公式な予定はis to meetで表します。

questions.prompt: All visitors are ------- their badges indoors.
questions.translationJa: 来訪者は館内で入館証を着用しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 規則上の義務をare to wearで示します。

questions.prompt: No solution is ------- without accurate data.
questions.translationJa: 正確なデータなしでは解決策は見つかりません。
questions.explanationJa: 否定文のbe to be foundで可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: The two founders were never ------- again.
questions.translationJa: 二人の創業者が再び共に働くことはありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 後から見た運命をwere never to workで表します。

questions.prompt: If the project is ------- on time, testing must start now.
questions.translationJa: 計画を期限内に終えるには、今試験を始めなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 目標達成条件はif ... is to finishです。

questions.prompt: The delegation was ------- at noon, but its flight was canceled.
questions.translationJa: 代表団は正午到着予定でしたが、便が欠航しました。
questions.explanationJa: 未実現の過去予定はwas to have arrivedです。

questions.prompt: Employees are not ------- personal devices in the lab.
questions.translationJa: 職員は実験室で私物端末を使ってはなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 否定のbe toで禁止を示します。

questions.prompt: Where are we ------- enough funding?
questions.translationJa: 十分な資金をいったいどこで見つけられるのでしょうか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文のbe toで可能性を問います。

questions.prompt: The chairperson is ------- the results at three.
questions.translationJa: 議長は3時に結果を発表する予定です。
questions.explanationJa: 公表済みの予定にis to announceを使います。

questions.prompt: The vessel was ------- a key role years later.
questions.translationJa: その船は数年後に重要な役割を果たす運命でした。
questions.explanationJa: 後の出来事を運命的に述べるwas to playです。

choices.D: The auditors are to arriving at nine.

questions.translationJa: 監査担当者は9時到着予定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a rule.

choices.A: Staff members to keep this door closed.
choices.B: Staff members are to kept this door closed.
choices.C: Staff members are keeping to this door closed.
choices.D: Staff members are to keep this door closed.

questions.translationJa: 職員はこの扉を閉めておかなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 規則による義務はare to keepです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about possibility.

choices.A: How am I to access the archive without a password?
choices.B: How I am to access the archive without a password?
choices.C: How am I access to the archive without a password?
choices.D: How am I to accessing the archive without a password?

questions.translationJa: パスワードなしでどうやって保管庫にアクセスできるのでしょうか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問語＋be＋主語＋to doで可能性を問います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about fate.

choices.A: The small workshop to become a global firm.
choices.B: The small workshop was to became a global firm.
choices.C: The small workshop was to become a global firm.
choices.D: The small workshop was to becoming a global firm.

questions.translationJa: その小さな工房は後に世界企業となる運命でした。
questions.explanationJa: 後の展開をwas to becomeで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a condition.

choices.A: If we will retain clients, service must improve in this be-to pattern.
choices.B: If we are retain to clients, service must improve.
choices.C: If we are to retained clients, service must improve.
choices.D: If we are to retain clients, service must improve.

questions.translationJa: 顧客を維持するにはサービス改善が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 目標条件にif we are to retainを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an unrealized plan.

choices.A: The shipment was to leave Tuesday and definitely did so despite the delay.
choices.B: The shipment was to have left Tuesday, but a strike delayed it.
choices.C: The shipment was to had left Tuesday, but a strike delayed it.
choices.D: The shipment was to having left Tuesday, but a strike delayed it.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は火曜発送予定でしたが、ストで遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: was to have leftが未実現予定を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a prohibition.

choices.A: Guests are not to enter the control room.
choices.B: Guests do not to enter the control room.
choices.C: Guests are not to entered the control room.
choices.D: Guests are not entering to the control room.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は制御室へ入ってはいけません。
questions.explanationJa: are not to enterで禁止を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a public announcement.

choices.A: The mayor is open to the new terminal Friday.
choices.B: The mayor to open the new terminal Friday.
choices.C: The mayor is to open the new terminal Friday.
choices.D: The mayor is to opened the new terminal Friday.

questions.translationJa: 市長は金曜に新ターミナルを開設する予定です。
questions.explanationJa: is to openが公式予定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about finding a replacement.

choices.A: No substitute was to found locally.
choices.B: No substitute was to be found locally.
choices.C: No substitute to be found was locally.
choices.D: No substitute was to being found locally.

questions.translationJa: 代替品は地元では見つかりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 受動形was to be foundで可能性の否定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about later history.

choices.A: The prototype was influence to many later models.
choices.B: The prototype was to influenced many later models.
choices.C: The prototype was to influencing many later models.
choices.D: The prototype was to influence many later models.

questions.translationJa: その試作品は後の多くの機種に影響を与えることになりました。
questions.explanationJa: 歴史的な帰結をwas to influenceで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The committee is to meet Thursday."

choices.A: The committee met last Thursday only.
choices.D: The committee is scheduled to meet Thursday.

questions.translationJa: 委員会は木曜に会合予定です。
questions.explanationJa: be to doの予定をbe scheduled toで言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "You are to submit both forms."

choices.A: You happened to submit one form.
choices.B: You are required to submit both forms.

questions.translationJa: 両方の用紙を提出しなければなりません。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "Where are we to store these samples?"

choices.A: Where did we store them yesterday?
choices.C: Where can these samples possibly be stored?

questions.translationJa: これらの試料をどこに保管できるのでしょうか。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "She was to lead the company for twenty years."

choices.A: She later became its leader and remained so for twenty years.

questions.translationJa: 彼女はその後20年間会社を率いることになりました。
questions.explanationJa: 後世から見た運命・展開です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "If the store is to survive, costs must fall."

choices.A: The store will certainly close today.
choices.B: Lower costs are necessary for the store's survival.

questions.translationJa: 店が存続するには費用削減が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: if＋be toが目標達成条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The guests were to have arrived at six."

choices.B: They began planning only after six.
choices.C: The guests had no travel plan.
choices.D: Six o'clock was the planned arrival time, but they did not arrive then.

questions.translationJa: 来客は6時到着予定でしたが、その時刻には到着しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: were to have arrivedは未実現予定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "Visitors are not to photograph the exhibits."

choices.A: Visitors are unable to see the exhibits.
choices.C: Visitors must not take photographs of the exhibits.

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は展示品を撮影してはいけません。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The president is to speak after lunch."

choices.A: An official speech by the president is scheduled after lunch.
choices.B: The president spoke before breakfast only.

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "No answer was to be found in the manual."

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The discovery was to transform the industry."

questions.prompt: The agenda is final. Ms. Grant is ------- the opening remarks.
questions.translationJa: 議題は確定しています。グラントさんが開会の言葉を述べる予定です。

questions.prompt: This area contains sensitive equipment. Visitors are ------- a guide.
questions.translationJa: この区域には精密機器があります。来訪者は案内係に従わなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 規則上の義務をare to followで示します。

questions.prompt: Every hotel is full. Where are the delegates ------- tonight?
questions.translationJa: どのホテルも満室です。代表者は今夜どこに泊まればよいのでしょうか。

questions.prompt: The inventor sold only ten units. Yet the device was ------- modern logistics.
questions.translationJa: 発明者は10台しか販売しませんでしたが、その装置は後に現代物流を変えることになりました。

questions.prompt: The team lacks a backup. If it is ------- by Friday, more engineers are needed.
questions.translationJa: チームには余裕がありません。金曜までに終えるには技術者追加が必要です。

questions.prompt: The technician was ------- the server overnight, but illness prevented the work.
questions.translationJa: 技術者は夜間にサーバーを更新する予定でしたが、病気で実施できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 未実現の予定はwas to have upgradedです。

questions.prompt: The documents are confidential. They are not ------- outside this room.
questions.translationJa: 文書は機密です。この部屋の外で複写してはいけません。
questions.explanationJa: 受動の禁止はare not to be copiedです。

questions.prompt: The schedule lists a noon ceremony. The governor is ------- the facility then.
questions.translationJa: 日程には正午の式典があり、知事がその時施設を開設予定です。
questions.explanationJa: 公式予定をis to openで表します。

questions.prompt: The code was ancient. No expert was ------- who understood it.

questions.prompt: The modest shop opened in 1950. It was ------- a national chain.

questions.explanationJa: 後の歴史的展開をwas to becomeで示します。
